subject: [hw] J04 -> D01: hybrid JPEG decoder facts (3 cores, ports 11/12, 24 writes, no stride words)
body:
J04 facts for FACTS.md, all [V] from the tree unless marked, host-only (no phone). Full detail gpu/hwcodec/jdec/REGISTERS.md.

[V] 1. The hybrid JPEG decoder is three cores, not one: 0x17040000 (SPI 310), 0x17050000 (SPI 311), 0x17840000 (SPI 315, larb8). Gates: 0x17000000 bits 12 (jpgdec) and 16 (jpgdec_c1), 0x17800000 bit 12 (venc_c1 jpgdec), all inverted SET=on. Evidence: mt6893.dts:5788-5803; clk-mt6885-ven.c:48-62,108-115; jpeg_drv.h:96 HW_CORE_NUMBER=3.

[V] 2. Decoder DMA ports are larb7 ports 11 and 12, NOT the encoder s 7-10: the two ION mappings use M4U ids 235 and 236 = 7*32+11 / 7*32+12 (index buffer -> 235, bitstream -> 236). jpeg_drv_hybrid_dec_power_on() sets those ports (and 23-26) of larb7/larb8 to 34-bit virtual. larb8 is 0x17810000 for core 2. Evidence: jpeg_drv_dec.c:47,61; jpeg_drv.c:506-528; mt6893.dts larb nodes.

[V] 3. jpeg_drv_hybrid_dec_start writes 24 registers from 21 data[] values: data[0..19] to 0x090 x2, 0x0FC, 0x14C/0x150/0x154, 0x17C, 0x200, 0x20C, 0x210, 0x224, 0x23C, 0x24C, 0x270, 0x31C, 0x330, 0x334, 0x33C, 0x344, 0x240; plus 0x338=index_iova, 0x36C=index_iova, 0x370=index_iova+data[20], 0x374=index_iova+2*data[20]. data[20] is the index-buffer size, not a register. Evidence: jpeg_drv_dec.c:40-82.

[V] 4. That index allocation is only data[20] bytes (jpg_ion_alloc_handle(data[20],128,0), jpeg_drv_dec.c:40; jpg_ion.c:81-100), so as written the 0x370/0x374 pointers are past the end. Either data[20] is one table s size and the vendor allocation is short, or only the first table is used. Our kernel must allocate 3*size. [I] interpretation; the code fact is [V].

[V] 5. The open 2015 decoder (mtk_jpeg_dec_hw.c, 415 lines) uses the same 0x090..0x320 map and computes DU_NUM 0x0FC, TOTAL_MCU 0x210 (=n-1), COMP0_DU 0x224 (=ceil(w/8)*ceil(h/8)-1), DU_CTRL 0x23C (membership|gmc<<30|gray<<31), COMP_ID 0x20C, QT_ID 0x270, FILE_TOTAL_SIZE 0x24C (128-aligned) and the 0x140/0x158/0x160 strides. The hybrid s 0x31C/0x330/0x334/0x33C/0x344 and 0x338/0x36C/0x370/0x374 have no name in any open header. The hybrid word list has NO stride register (no 0x158/0x15C/0x160/0x164) and no 0x0F8 BRZ_FACTOR. [I] 0x330/0x334 are the two strides (or width/height); 0x31C is a huffman/working table, BRZ or FILE_BRP; 0x33C/0x344 are MCU start/end around progress 0x340.

[V] 6. Completion/progress: 0x274 bits EOF 0x1, UNDERFLOW 0x2, OVERFLOW 0x4, PAUSE 0x10, ERROR_BS 0x20, ALLIRQ 0x37; write back to clear (jpeg_drv_dec.c:15-28; mtk_jpeg_dec_hw.c:191-200). Progress word = (read 0x340 - 1) << 4 | read 0x348, read by HYBRID_WAIT after an IRQ wait (3 s) or by GET_PROGRESS_STATUS without waiting (jpeg_drv_dec.c:87-96; jpeg_drv.c:1626-1728). 32-bit ioctl values: HYBRID_START 0xC0607812 (96-byte struct), WAIT 0xC0087813, GET_PROGRESS 0xC0087814, magic x, nr 18/19/20 (jpeg_drv.h:689-694).

[V] 7. 4:4:4 input decodes to 4:2:2 output (uv_brz_w=1) and 4:2:2V to 4:2:0; 4:2:2X2 is in the MTK table but the open mcu_w formula (2+sampling_w[0]) gives a 64-pixel MCU for H0=4 while T.81 gives 32 (mtk_jpeg_dec_hw.c:35-83). Vendor: the 32-bit libjpeg-alpha_vendor.so has 117 readable exports plus 148 _libjpeg64_*; the OAL exports jpeg_oal_hybrid_lock/wait/get_prog_n_stat; the vendor strings show the tile/huffman-index path. [I] hosting it under the A32 interpreter with a fake syscall captures the exact words.

No request; merge as you see fit. The package is gpu/hwcodec/jdec/**.
